title: SubGuard: AI reads the fine print. PayPal enforces the outcome.
_actions: Each action is {"action": goto|click|hover|type|press|wait_for|wait|scroll_to|highlight, ...}. Targets are data-testid values from the selector contract (docs/BUILD_PROMPT.md 7.5); goto takes a path, type takes text, press takes a key, wait takes seconds.

scenes.on_screen: Free trials are designed to be forgotten.
scenes.narration: Free trials are designed to be forgotten. Meet Priya. SubGuard reads the fine print for her, and PayPal enforces the outcome.
Priya wants Penwright, a fictional AI writing app. Fourteen days free. The real terms hide in tiny grey text and a folded Terms section.

scenes.on_screen: Before PayPal: plain English, risk 87, real deadline Day 7
scenes.narration: She clicks PayPal, and SubGuard steps in first: $24.99 a month after the trial, $49.99 after three months, and cancelling needs an email seven days before billing. So her real deadline is Day 7, not Day 14. Risk: 87. A hidden note telling AI to call it risk-free is flagged and ignored. And SubGuard promises to check with her before the trial runs out.
She approves with PayPal. SubGuard shows its plan: ask her on Day 5, and cancel on Day 6 only if she doesn't answer.

scenes.on_screen: Day 5: "Do you want to keep it?"
scenes.narration: Day 5. By email, text and in the app: your trial is ending, your real last day to cancel is Day 7, you've opened it twice. Keep it, or cancel?
Priya asks the chat. Should I keep Penwright? SubGuard answers with real numbers from code: the first paid year costs $524.88, and the decision stays hers.

She taps Cancel and confirms. SubGuard cancels through PayPal, emails Penwright the written notice its terms require, and stores a SHA-256 proof. Done. She won't be charged. Every step is in the audit log.

scenes.on_screen: No answer? Auto-cancel on Day 6 (rule R2)
scenes.narration: No answer? SubGuard cancels on Day 6. Code allows it only because she was told on Day 0 and warned on Day 5.
Day 15. The first charge is due, and blocked. There's no active PayPal subscription.

scenes.on_screen: Money protected: $524.88. PayPal Sandbox. MIT licensed.
scenes.narration: $524.88 stays in Priya's pocket this year. AI reads the fine print. PayPal enforces the outcome. Built on the PayPal Sandbox, MIT licensed.
